posts.content:
Dear Besant Nagar residents and beach lovers,

We are pleased to announce the official rollout of 24 segregated eco-bins along Elliot Beach Promenade, partnered with our local youth volunteers. The community cleanup drive starts this Saturday at 6:30 AM.

Please join us near the Schmidt Memorial with gloves and reusable water bottles. Refreshments will be provided by local neighborhood bakeries.
posts.title: 🚨 Official Advisory: Beach Promenade Coastal Cleanup & Eco-Bin Installation

posts.content:
Great news for morning walkers and cyclists! Greater Chennai Corporation has approved our community proposal for raised pedestrian crossings, solar-powered crosswalk blinkers, and 50 native saplings along 4th Main Road.

Work will commence next Tuesday from 10 PM to 4 AM to minimize traffic impact.
posts.title: Local News: New Pedestrian Crossings and Tree Canopies Approved for 4th Main Road

posts.content: Sharing a quick photo from yesterday evening acoustic veena recital at Spaces. It is so heartwarming to see the neighborhood come alive with classical arts under the banyan tree. Who else is attending the weekend vocal concert?
posts.title: Margazhi & Classical Music Gathering at Spaces Arts Compound

posts.content: This is a private update for verified Besant Nagar members. Here is the volunteer patrol roster for the interior streets around 6th Avenue. If you notice any defunct street lights, please drop the pole number below so our ward coordinator can expedite repairs.
posts.title: Resident-Only: Neighborhood Security & Night Patrol Roster (Feb-Mar)

posts.content: The old parish apple orchard needs some pruning and fresh organic mulching before spring blossom. Looking for 8-10 volunteers this coming Sunday at 10 AM. Bring your garden shears!
posts.title: Greenfield Village Orchard Restoration Project — Spring Volunteers Needed

comments.content: I will definitely be there with my family! Will there be collection bags for microplastics on the sand?
Yes Deepa! We have special fine mesh sifters and biodegradable collection bags sponsored by Coastal Clean India.
Much needed initiative. The pedestrian crossings will make it so much safer for children walking to Olcott School.
Pole #42 on 6th Avenue has been reported to TANGEDCO. Repair crew scheduled for tomorrow 11 AM.
